keyVerseDR: "Now the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing." (Rom 15:13)

level1.title: This Week's Catholic Virtue: Hope
level1.story: Hope means expecting good things and working for them, trusting that God holds our future.
level1.heartIntro: Hang this sheet on the fridge and practice hope all week. On Saturday, talk together, write what you practiced, and a parent signs.
questions: What are we hoping for, and how can we work toward it?
When did God bring good out of a hard time?
actions: Hang this sheet on the fridge
level1.prayer: God of hope, fill me with joy and peace. I trust my future to You. Amen.

activity.title: Daily Action Checklist
activity.intro: Color a star each day, Monday through Saturday. Hang this sheet on the fridge and practice with your family. A parent signs at the end of the week.
items: MON: Say: 'God is with me' when things go wrong
TUE: Make a wish and pray about it
WED: Cheer up someone who feels sad
THU: Look forward to something good
FRI: Plant a seed and wait for it to grow
SAT: Pray for someone who needs hope

level2.title: This Week's Catholic Virtue: Hope
level2.story: Hope means expecting the best, working toward it, and trusting that a good future can be built with God. A hopeful person does not give up when things go wrong, because God is always at work. Saint Paul calls Him the God of hope, who fills us with joy and peace. Our greatest hope is heaven, where we will be with God forever.
level2.heartIntro: Hang this sheet on the fridge and practice hope all week. On Saturday, talk together, write what you practiced, and a parent signs.
questions: What are we hoping for, and how can we work toward it?
How did God help us grow in hope?
actions: Hang this sheet on the fridge
level2.prayer: God of hope, fill me with joy and peace. I trust my future to You. Amen.

activity.title: Daily Action Checklist
activity.intro: Color a star each day, Monday through Saturday. Hang this sheet on the fridge and practice with your family. A parent signs at the end of the week.
items: MON: Set a goal and take a first step
TUE: Find something good in a hard day
WED: Encourage someone who is discouraged
THU: Pray for people who are suffering
FRI: Remember a time God helped our family
SAT: Talk about heaven as a family
